response.sql: WITH scan_site AS (SELECT s.gbsize / s.spanmin AS rate, st.healtheval FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0), status_stats AS (SELECT healtheval, AVG(rate) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS count_scans FROM scan_site GROUP BY healtheval), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS all_avg FROM scan_site), filtered AS (SELECT ss.avg_rate, ss.count_scans, oa.all_avg FROM status_stats ss CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ss.avg_rate > oa.all_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_rate), AVG(count_scans), AVG(avg_rate) - (SELECT all_avg FROM overall_avg) FROM filtered
